brief:
The United States has presented six demands to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu regarding Gaza, according to Ma'an Wire. The demands focus on reconstruction efforts and governance frameworks for the enclave following military operations.

Details of the specific demands were not immediately disclosed. The move reflects Washington's growing engagement with Israeli leadership on postwar planning and civilian recovery in Gaza.

title: US demands Netanyahu outline Gaza reconstruction plan
